name: Requirements Traceability Matrix
notes: Landscape pages. Page 2 prints its own title bar, "INTER-REQUIREMENTS TRACEABILITY MATRIX", and repeats the Project Title / Date Prepared header. Page 1 prints a grouped header row: "Requirement Information" spans ID to Category and "Relationship Traceability" spans Business Objective to Validation; keep both header rows. Page 2 has no group header; ID, Priority and Source each print twice, once for the business requirement and once for the technical requirement on the same row. Despite the kind "matrix" in forms-index.md, both pages are registers with one row per requirement and fixed columns, not a grid crossing two dimensions. The prose table 2.6 (PDF 53) lists Category before Priority; the blank page 1 prints Priority before Category, which wins.
